title: Count Valid Suffix Sorts II
statement: For every length-n window of target (n <= m <= 10^5), it counts indices i where sorting nums[i..n-1] in non-increasing order makes nums equal that window. The reduction: a window can match only if it is an anagram of nums (sliding frequency-count window); valid i then form an interval, capped by the window's longest common prefix with nums (one Z-function pass) and floored by where its non-increasing tail starts.
